quests.title: The Soft Song She Sang

dialogue.t: ...That big guy was chained up back there... In the end, this lighthouse is where he always wanted to be, huh?
But that young lady, that shadow... She was only human, so she shouldn't have been able to live this long...
So what was that shadow, really?

dialogue.sit: The wishes of that young lady herself gave it form, perhaps...
Perhaps it was comprised of the Snegovik's wishes...

dialogue.t: Hmm, maybe this is one of those cases where you think about something hard enough and your body actually moves in the direction you're thinking about without you noticing.
Right. Maybe that shadow... was also able to remain here to this day because she held on to her desire to see this big guy...
The big guy... He's walking beneath the waves... Paimon has a feeling we'll never see him again.
...Well, not that Paimon knows if he can hear us.

quests.description: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you’ll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first…
